name: Chris Ray
source:
She is the elite of the elite born and grown up in Ray family that enjoys a high reputation in Yugudora Kingdom.
She belongs to The Knights of Seiryuu together with her brother.
She performs intelligence mission in the kingdom, appearing and disapperaing mysteriously.
Having a strong sense of self-esteem, she is taciturn and hard to get along with.
For certain reasons she harboured resentment against Towa, aiming at his life.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
